$comment: The weapon actions a hero trained in a weapon unlocks with it, as Baldur's Gate's 'Proficiency unlocks' (src/rules/WeaponActions.ts): each action its name, what it does (as the tooltip tells it), what it leaves on its target (effect: bleeding, dazed, prone, crippled, weakened, disarmed, cleave, shot, brace) and whether the game plays it yet (worked: false, shown in the weapon's tooltip only, with a placeholder icon until their art is made). weapons: each weapon of src/data/weapons.json and the actions it unlocks (none listed: none).

lacerate.name: Lacerate
lacerate.text: Slash a foe open: it bleeds for 2 turns, and has disadvantage on Constitution saving throws.

pommel_strike.name: Pommel Strike
pommel_strike.text: Strike with the hilt: the foe is dazed for 2 turns unless it makes a Constitution save.

cleave.name: Cleave
cleave.text: Swing in a wide arc and strike up to 3 foes before you, for half damage each.

topple.name: Topple
topple.text: Sweep at the foe's legs: it falls prone unless it makes a Dexterity save.

rush_attack.name: Rush Attack
rush_attack.text: Charge through the foes in a line, striking each and knocking them prone.

piercing_strike.name: Piercing Strike
piercing_strike.text: Drive the point deep: the foe bleeds for 2 turns.

concussive_smash.name: Concussive Smash
concussive_smash.text: A blow to the head: the foe is dazed for 2 turns unless it makes a Constitution save.

weakening_strike.name: Weakening Strike
weakening_strike.text: Bruise the foe's limbs: its weapon attacks have disadvantage for 2 turns.

backbreaker.name: Backbreaker
backbreaker.text: Crush the foe to the ground: it falls prone unless it makes a Strength save.

crippling_strike.name: Crippling Strike
crippling_strike.text: Hamper the foe's legs: it is crippled, its speed halved, for 2 turns.

disarming_strike.name: Disarming Strike
disarming_strike.text: Knock the weapon from the foe's hand unless it makes a Strength save.

flourish.name: Flourish
flourish.text: A dazzling feint and cut: the foe is distracted, and your next attack against it has advantage.

heartstopper.name: Heartstopper
heartstopper.text: A blow to the chest: the foe's next attack roll and saving throw have disadvantage.

piercing_shot.name: Piercing Shot
piercing_shot.text: A shot that tears the wound wide: the foe bleeds for 2 turns.

hamstring_shot.name: Hamstring Shot
hamstring_shot.text: A shot at the legs: the foe's speed is halved for 2 turns.

mobile_shot.name: Mobile Shot
mobile_shot.text: Shoot on the move, and step away without drawing a blow.

brace.name: Brace
brace.text: Set yourself: your next attack's damage dice are rolled twice, keeping the higher.

tenacity.name: Tenacity
tenacity.text: A blow that wears the foe down: it takes your Strength modifier in damage even on a miss.
